_comment: Roles Kasi has marked 'Not interested' on the dashboard.
HOW THIS WORKS: the GitHub Pages site is static, so it cannot write back here
by itself. Kasi ticks 'Not interested' on a job; the choice is saved in his
browser and the job disappears from his list immediately. The dashboard's
'Export exclusions' button then gives a JSON block to paste into this file
and commit — from then on the PIPELINE excludes those roles at source, on
MATCHING: entries match on company + normalised title, NOT on job_id, so an
employer reposting the same role under a new requisition id stays excluded.
Set "title_norm" to the lowercased title, or use "title_contains" for a
looser match. Leave "company" empty to exclude that role at every employer.

_example.reason: wants housekeeping, not guest-facing butler service
example only — would drop every laundry role everywhere
